neighbours.label: best guess: words for a change or difference of manner / place (' shifted' to, ' differently', 'not in the same way')
fire: Smuggling had not ended; it had merely shifted to the quieter harbours further north.
Sound travels through water differently to the way it travels through air.
The older workers were affected too, although not in the same way as the young.
After the factory closed, employment simply shifted to the service sector.
Clay soils hold water differently to sandy ones, which matters for farmers.
The disease affects women as well, but not in the same way it affects men.
Over the decade the fishing grounds gradually shifted to deeper and colder waters.
Glass conducts heat differently to metal, so the two expand at unequal rates.
quiet: Smuggling had not ended; it had merely continued in the quieter harbours further north.
Sound travels through water much faster than it travels through air.
The older workers were affected too, and so were most of the young.
After the factory closed, employment in the service sector grew.
Clay soils hold more water than sandy ones, which matters for farmers.
The disease affects women as well, and it affects men more often.
Over the decade the fishing grounds gradually emptied of cod and herring.
Glass conducts heat poorly and metal conducts it well, so the two feel unlike.
